summary: The code is syntactically valid and includes several core components (agents, small-world network, enforcement, supply market). However, it lacks a runnable simulation loop, metrics computation, and integration of key interactions. The main() function is correctly called but does nothing. Multiple parameter mismatches with the provided specification and missing behaviors render the implementation incomplete.

issues.description: No simulation loop (e.g., run() method) to advance days, update states, and compute metrics. As a result, the simulation does not execute.
issues.location: Simulation class (missing run method) and main()
issues.solution: Implement a Simulation.run() method that iterates over days, updates policies, computes peer influence, broadcasts information, updates adoption decisions, handles supply acquisition, simulates visits/enforcement, updates fatigue/habit, logs metrics, and returns results. Call this method from main().

issues.description: main() is a no-op; although it is correctly called at global scope, it does not set up parameters or run the simulation.
issues.location: main() function at top of file
issues.solution: Populate main() to parse or define parameters, construct Simulation(params), call run(), and optionally print or save results.

issues.description: Key interactions and behaviors from the specification are not integrated: peer influence, information diffusion, policy enforcement, mobility/contacts, and supply acquisition are only partially implemented and never executed together.
issues.location: Simulation class (missing integration across helper methods)
issues.solution: Within run(), sequence the daily steps: compute neighbor adoption fractions; construct authority and media signals; call Person.receive_information; calculate base attitudes; use Person.decide_adoption; request masks from SupplyMarket if needed; call SupplyMarket.update_daily and allocate; update adoption states based on allocation; simulate visits via _simulate_visits_and_enforcement; update fatigue/habit; log metrics.

issues.description: Parameter names do not match the provided spec, causing defaults to diverge and user-provided configs to be ignored.
issues.solution: Map spec keys to internal names: random_seed->seed; simulation_duration_days->time_horizon_days; time_step_days (respect if needed); mask_supply_level (normalize units or adapt); supply_restock_rate_per_day->production_rate; enforcement_probability; and use campaign_start_day, misinformation_start_day consistently.

issues.description: Adoption decisions ignore actual mask inventory/supply constraints beyond decrementing inventory during update; individuals can 'adopt' even with zero inventory.
issues.location: Person.decide_adoption and Simulation daily adoption update (missing)
issues.solution: Gate adoption_state=true on having inventory>0. If will_adopt but inventory==0, queue a demand request and only set adoption_state after allocation succeeds.

issues.description: Metrics listed in the spec are not computed or exposed. Only partial containers exist.
issues.location: Simulation.history and absence of metric computation
issues.solution: Compute and store: adoption_rate_over_time, final_adoption_rate, peak_adoption_rate with day, time_to_50_percent_adoption, compliance_rate_under_mandate, violation_rate, adoption_by_location_type, and campaign_effect_lift (requires baseline without campaign or counterfactual tracking). Return these in results.

issues.description: Authority/media information diffusion and peer influence are not combined into per-day attitudes that drive adoption, and decay effects/influence decay not modeled.
issues.location: Simulation (missing daily attitude update) and parameters influence_decay_per_day
issues.solution: Maintain a per-person latent attitude state with inertia; update it each day with weighted peer influence (with decay), authority and media signals, and personal traits; clamp to [-1,1].

issues.description: Mobility and contacts are very simplified and do not reflect capacity/contact rates or movement beyond a single random location per person.
issues.solution: Incorporate capacity limits, allow multiple contacts per location proportional to contact_rate, optionally track observed compliance norms by location to influence future attitudes.

issues.description: SupplyMarket.update_daily uses an internal distribution_rate but does not relate to actual allocated units or population demand pressure realistically.
issues.solution: Base sold/allocated units on allocation outcome; update supply with production; price dynamics should consider demand vs supply ratio and possibly moving average of demand.

issues.description: MediaChannel.reach is unused in broadcasting; all persons appear equally affected regardless of reach.
issues.location: MediaChannel.broadcast_messages and Simulation (missing use of reach)
issues.solution: During information diffusion, apply media_signal only to a random subset of the population proportional to reach, or scale the signal accordingly.

issues.location: Top-level imports: argparse, csv, json, statistics, sys
issues.solution: Remove unused imports or use them if you plan to add CLI and I/O.

issues.description: Docstrings reference methods that do not exist (save_results, visualize).
issues.solution: Either implement these methods or update the docstring to reflect current functionality.

issues.description: Parameter time_step_days from the spec is ignored; simulation implicitly uses daily steps.
issues.solution: Respect time_step_days or clearly document that steps are daily and adjust if time_step_days != 1.
